locations.note: Ramosé, a young Theban, tries to clear his father of accusations of robbing the tomb of Seti I.
Ramosé finds the former draughtsman Hori dead in his cellar, with clues pointing to the embalmers.
At the Festival Hall of Thutmose III he finds part of the loot and documents that implicate Ptahnéfer, a relative of the pharaoh.

routes.name: Ramosé
routes.note: From the workmen's village to the Festival Hall at Karnak.
